details.detail: Overall massing, wall height and cap. H 1.30 plus an 0.085 cap matches the published 53 in door height. The thick taupe bullnose on every wall reads right in q02, s1 and s3 against omaat_f7, f49 and f31. Rendered cap #aba595 in q02 against about #8f8569 in the real photos, which is acceptable.

Aisle exterior and doors. The parked leaves are not symmetric: the aft fluted panel is 0.86 m and the forward one 0.26 m. In real photos the two fluted leaves are roughly equal (about 0.45-0.5 m each) and park at each end of an opening about 1.3 leaf-widths wide. The fixed walls behind or beside the leaves are dark straight-grain wood, not fluted.

Window-suite screen wall. The 43 in screen, wood wing, stowed table with black lip and aisle box are all present. The aisle-side pier is too narrow: 0.158 m, where the photo gives a pier/screen ratio of 188/610 px ≈ 0.31 (≈0.22-0.29 m after perspective). The pier also wraps toward the seat. The mirror is a small black slab (0.10 × 0.36, rendered #0c0d0e); the real one is a tall reflective pill (≈0.15 × 0.47) reading #667fa1-#6a7791.

Centre-suite screen wall. It no longer floats in the aisle (the r3 fix works). The mirror is now a 0.058 m slot. In omaat_f3 and f5 the centre suites have the same pill mirror and pier as the window suites, which suggests the real centre suite is wider than 1.10 m.

Window console. The order (handset aft, tilted keypad, tapered wood tray) and the outlet pocket match f_17313, omaat_f7 and up_privacy_wall. The real console top is a sculpted, recessed trough rather than a flat top with an inset. That is acceptable at cabin distance.

Centre divider. The large wood face with a thin taupe top rail and tab now matches up_privacy_wall and f_17314 in shape. In the cabin the wood renders #271f1d, against #443836 in up_privacy_wall and #6e5146 in f_17314.

Seat. The massing, seams, two lamps and lavender pillow are right. Three problems: the headrest flap renders darker than the back (#454847) and reads as a screen, where real flaps are lighter than the back (omaat_f9 flap #8d8f8a vs back #817a71; f5 #7a796f vs #6e5c55); the leg-rest loft juts out of the seat front as a separate plate; and the seat is narrower than the published 34 in (console face to armrest inner face = 0.735 m, about 29 in).

Ottoman. The model builds a solid box from the floor (gRBox ow × 0.36). In reality the padded bench is cantilevered, with a taupe rail under the cushion and an open dark void and floor plinth beneath.

Bed mode. The pad, duvet, fold, white pillow and lavender pillow run seat to ottoman, as in omaat_f46 and f47. The three duvet 'wrinkles' are thin half-cylinders that render as straight rods lying on the bed (q04, s5). The pad is 1.96 m, against the published 81 in (2.06 m) bed.
Seat plaques. Small dark tiles with light text at the forward end of the wardrobe cap. The size and place are now right. The real tile is lighter grey with blue-lit text (omaat_f7 and f49 '2K').
Materials under cabin light. The interior still renders far darker than the photos. Ottoman top #433d3e vs #6d6969 (f_17314) and #686168 (f_17313); table #342f2e; pier and mirror #0d0e0f.

issues.problem: The parked door leaves are asymmetric (0.86 m aft vs 0.26 m forward), and no wood fixed walls show on the aisle exterior
issues.detail: In suiteUnit the fluted panels span [-0.96,-0.10] and [-L+0.12,-L+0.38]. A 0.43+ m leaf cannot park in a 0.26 m wall, and the 0.86 aft run is about twice a leaf. The real aisle face shows two equal fluted leaves at the ends of the opening; with the doors closed, dark straight-grain wood fixed walls flank them.
issues.evidence: omaat_f7.jpg: parked leaves ≈330 px and ≈360 px wide, opening ≈460 px (≈1.3 leaf). up_empty.jpg: forward parked leaf beside the ottoman is as wide as the aft one. pb_20.jpg and omaat_f49.jpg: closed, two ≈490 px leaves with ~21 ribs each, flanked by wood walls. Studio w_aisle.png and s6: wide aft / narrow forward fluted panels.
issues.fix: In the !lod exterior loop, replace the panel list with two equal leaves: [[-0.96,-0.46],[-L+0.10,-L+0.60]] (0.50 m each, rib pitch 0.024 gives about 20 ribs). Extend the front outer wall (gRBox(0.04,H,0.26) at z -L+0.25) to gRBox(0.04,H,0.50) at z -L+0.35, with its cap to match, so the forward leaf has a wall to park on. Add an fWood exterior panel in a 0.035 taupe (fShell) frame at x hx+0.004 on the remaining wardrobe run z [-0.46,-0.08], y 0.14..H-0.10. Move the silver pulls to the leaves' opening edges: z -0.96+0.035 and -L+0.60-0.035.

issues.problem: Duvet wrinkles render as straight rods
issues.detail: Each of the three gCyl(0.012, …, ln, 8, half) creases is a rigid tube with a specular highlight. In q04 they read as sticks lying on a flat white slab.
issues.evidence: q04_suite1Abed.png: three thin bright lines at x≈410, 545, 665. omaat_f46.jpg and pb_38.jpg: broad, low, soft folds and a rumpled duvet edge hanging over the pad side.
issues.fix: Delete the gCyl creases. Build the duvet as gLoft(cushionSecs(0.70,1.55,…)) with a crown that varies along its length, or as 2-3 overlapping cushionSecs slabs 0.25-0.4 m long at slightly different heights (Δy 0.01-0.015) and yaw (±3°), with edge 0.05. Let the window-side edge droop 0.03 over the pad, and lengthen the fold at z -0.50 to 0.30 × 0.05.

issues.problem: The screen-wall mirror is a small black slab and the aisle pier is too narrow
issues.detail: The window-suite pier is 0.158 wide and the mirror 0.10 × 0.36, with glass #1c1d20. In the real suite the pier is wider, angled toward the seat, and holds a tall pill mirror that reflects the cabin.
issues.evidence: omaat_f10.jpg: screen 610 px, aisle pier 188 px, mirror 95 × 300 px (≈0.15 × 0.47 m), glass #667fa1. up_4k_screen.jpg glass #6a7791. q03_suite1A.png: mirror and pier #0c0d0e.
issues.fix: Glass: use SEATMAT.mirror ({c:'#aeb6bf', r:0.08, m:0.9}) or {c:'#6f7f98', r:0.1, m:0.6} instead of '#1c1d20'. Mirror 0.13 × 0.44 at y 0.93. Window suite: reduce the wing to 0.08 and yaw the pier gRBox about its screen-side edge by about 20° toward the seat (rotate about y at x = pX0, z = -L+0.12), so a 0.22 face fits within hx. Keep the lamp at the pier's outer top corner.

issues.problem: The ottoman is a solid box to the floor; the real one is a cantilevered bench with an open void beneath
issues.detail: gRBox(ow,0.36,0.52) at y 0.18 fills everything under the cushion.
issues.evidence: omaat_f10.jpg: cushion on a thin taupe rail (y 755-775 px) with a dark open cavity to the floor and a low plinth. up_empty.jpg: bench with an open shelf under it. f_17313: ottoman #686168.
issues.fix: Replace the base box with a thin support slab gRBox(ow,0.05,0.52) at y 0.335, a taupe front rail gRBox(ow,0.03,0.02) at y 0.30, z -L+0.65, and a low plinth gRBox(ow,0.06,0.45) at y 0.03, using SEATMAT.black or '#2a2724' for the recess back wall. Bed mode keeps its gRBox fill.

issues.problem: The headrest flap renders dark and reads as a screen; real flaps are lighter than the back
issues.detail: fFlap '#666864' with the leather layer, tilted -6°, renders #454847 in studio s4.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9.jpg flap #8d8f8a vs back #817a71. omaat_f5.jpg flap #7a796f vs back #6e5c55. omaat_f1 and f31: pale grey-green flap.
issues.fix: Shared SEATMAT line in 09_seats.js: fFlap: {c:'#8c8e88', r:0.55, l:LAYER.leather}. Make the flap 0.50 × 0.18 with a 0.02 corner radius, and drop the -6° tilt to -2° so it lies on the back.

issues.problem: The leg-rest loft juts out of the seat front as a separate plate
issues.detail: loftAt at S·trs(0,0.06,-0.70,0,-14°) leans its 0.30 height forward past the base's front face (base front at z -0.81 world), leaving a dark gap.
issues.evidence: s4_suiteW_seat.png lower edge: light band #aa9e9c separated from the base. omaat_f9.jpg and f5.jpg: seat front is a flush vertical padded panel with one seam.
issues.fix: Use rotation -3° and z -0.675 (so it touches the base's front face at -0.67 local), and match the width to the base (0.64-0.66).

issues.problem: The seat is narrow against the published 34 in
issues.detail: Console face (xo+shelfW = -0.40) to armrest inner face (≈0.335) is 0.735 m (29 in). The cushion is 0.66.
issues.evidence: thepointsanalyst.com: 'seat 34 inches wide', 'bed 81 inches long'. omaat_f9: the cushion fills console to armrest.
issues.fix: Cushion and base width 0.72, seatX = xo+shelfW+0.04+0.36; bed pad 0.72 × 2.02 from z -0.06 to -2.08, running under the table.

issues.problem: The centre suite's mirror is a 0.058 slot
issues.evidence: omaat_f3.jpg: centre suite 2D has a pier with a full-size pill mirror beside its screen.
issues.fix: Either widen the centre suite (see questions) or move the centre mirror to the divider-side wing: a 0.02 wing cannot hold it, so give the aisle pier 0.12 by shifting the screen 0.03 toward the divider (wing 0 with the bezel butting the divider frame).

issues.problem: Everything inside the suite renders too dark (lighting area)
issues.detail: Mentioned only briefly because it belongs to lighting.
issues.evidence: Ottoman top #433d3e vs #6d6969 (f_17314); divider wood #271f1d vs #443836 (up_privacy_wall).
issues.fix: This belongs to the lighting owner (12_scene.js): raise interior fill and AO floor inside the F shells. Also note the blocky sun patches on the bed in q04.

questionsForUser: Photos suggest the real centre suites (1D/1G) are wider than the modelled 1.10 m: a full-size mirror pier plus the 43 in screen needs about 1.2 m. Do you have a seat map or cabin drawing with the F suite widths, or should I widen the centre suites and narrow the aisles?

Should the suite doors support a closed state (two fluted leaves meeting at a centre pull, with wood walls exposed), for example toggled in walk mode? Many real photos (pb_20, omaat_f49, roame_20) show them closed.
